name: uidiff
description: Captures a page on your local dev server before and after a code change, and produces a drag-to-compare HTML report with a pixel-accurate diff. Swaps changed files to a git ref to rebuild the "before" state, drives Chrome directly over the DevTools Protocol, and skips changes that couldn't possibly render differently (docs, tests, config). macOS-only, built for JS/Next.js dev servers, no npm dependencies.
